children: According to Sina Finance, the European Union and the Philippines said in a joint statement that they have reached a "substantial agreement" on a free trade deal. European Commission President Ursula von der Leyen said after meeting with Philippine President Ferdinand Marcos that she looks forward to traveling to the Philippines in 2027 to sign the agreement.

title: EU and Philippines Reach Substantial Agreement on Free Trade Deal
